flujo.name: FLUJO
flujo.line: Build private AI agents visually. Then talk to them, automate them, or call them from other software.

factory.name: FACTORY
factory.line: Give it a mission and a budget. It runs a crew of AI workers and keeps a record of every job.

flujo-cloud.name: flujo-cloud
flujo-cloud.line: Take a FLUJO flow from your PC and run it on your own private cloud machine.

brain.name: brain
brain.line: Your agents as a living 3D brain. Watch every thought fire in real time.

seagulled.name: seagulled
seagulled.line: Tell Todd your goal. He hands it to teams of AI workers and checks what they bring back.

communityai.name: CommunityAI
communityai.line: AI powered by people. Everyone lends a bit of their PC to run one shared model. Built on Petals.

virtual-computer.name: mcp-virtual-computer
virtual-computer.line: A computer for your AI, and for you. Watch it type and click on a 3D desk.

audio-studio.name: mcp-audio-studio
audio-studio.line: A full music studio that you and the AI make tracks in together.

vscode.name: mcp-vscode
vscode.line: A real VS Code that you and the AI share: same files, same terminal.

cad-studio.name: mcp-cad-studio
cad-studio.line: 3D design. The AI builds the part, you edit the same one.

sandbox.name: mcp-sandbox-computer
sandbox.line: Named Linux computers for AI agents. Based on Kilntainers.

video-studio.name: mcp-video-studio
video-studio.line: A multi-track video editor for people and AI.

abap-adt.name: mcp-abap-adt
abap-adt.line: Lets an AI read code straight out of an SAP system.

sap-gui.name: mcp-sap-gui
sap-gui.line: Lets an AI click and type its way through SAP GUI.

windows-automation.name: mcp-windows-automation
windows-automation.line: Lets an AI drive Windows apps with mouse and keyboard.

fruit-fly.name: ai-fruit-fly
fruit-fly.line: A real fruit fly brain, all 138,639 neurons, running in your browser. Then 1,024 flies learned to code a rotating döner.
